jobs.title: Sr Project Manager
jobs.location: Las Rozas de Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain
jobs.description:
At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values —"We Care. We Work. We Win.”— we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress.

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Create a new future. Apply Today.

Your Opportunity to Make an Impact

At Ball, the Sr Project Manager plays a critical role in leading complex capital and manufacturing projects from planning through implementation. Working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, finance, and plant teams, this role ensures projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget while supporting operational excellence and business growth.

How You'll Make a Difference

Establish, monitor, and revise project schedules using critical path methodologies to achieve project objectives.
Lead the planning and implementation of assigned projects, ensuring alignment with budget, timeline, and operational requirements.
Coordinate feasibility studies and evaluate project options in collaboration with key stakeholders across the business.
Prepare AFEs and requisitions with detailed scopes of work, accurate cost estimates, and clear project justifications.
Manage project budgets and forecasting activities while maintaining accurate project accounting records.
Provide regular project status updates covering progress, costs, risks, issues, and schedule performance.
Build, lead, and influence cross-functional project teams, including engineering, manufacturing, and external partners.
Ensure engineering documentation, work orders, and change controls comply with approved standards and project requirements.
Support a safe work environment by adhering to all company safety policies and procedures.
Leverage project management and business systems to maintain accountability, communication, and project visibility.

What Helps You Thrive In This Role

University degree or equivalent education in Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
Minimum of 3 years of experience leading project implementation activities.
Minimum of 2 years of experience leading others to achieve common goals.
Strong understanding of manufacturing equipment and production processes.
Excellent organizational, self-motivation, and action-oriented problem-solving skills.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders.
Working knowledge of project management principles, including scope definition, scheduling, monitoring, and risk management.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and business systems such as Coupa, JDE, and project scheduling tools.
Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and project cost control.

Sr Project Manager must possess excellent relationship buidling and influencing skills since they will lead people that are outside their direct reporting line. While the regular working cycle of this position is usually five days on (Monday-Friday), this job may include working weekends (Saturday and Sunday). Working hours may vary as specified by management and/or as required by project needs. Incumbent must be able to work overtime on a regular basis and/or be on call as directed by management.

Work Environment: This role supports central functions and offers flexible work arrangements including hybrid or fully remote options, subject to role requirements and manager approval.

Hiring Range: 671250- 895000 SEK gross per year - The final salary will be determined based on the candidate’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and market benchmarks. Depending on these factors, the actual offer may fall above or below the posted range.

Incentive Plan
: The position is eligible for a bonus under the bonus system communicated by the company at each occasion.

Comprehensive Benefits Package:
For specific details and eligibility see Teknikavtalet Unionen, Ledarna och Sveriges ingengörer. Pension plan via Collectum. Life insurance, insurance for work accident long-term sick leave, parental leave and Insurance transition support Ball offer employees Friskvårdsbidrag, Gruppförsäkring Skandia, lunch Benefit and employee assistance program.

The management team is also offered quick access to healthcare Access Deductible.

The salary range is provided for candidates from PRIMARY LOCATION COUNTRY. For other locations, information regarding salary will be shared during the recruitment process.

If you have a disability and/or long-term health condition that impacts your ability to access any of the information outlined in the job application process, please do not hesitate in letting us know, so that we can endeavour to provide it you in the most accessible format. Please email jobs.emea@ball.com with your access request, and somebody will respond to you within 3 business days.

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles solutions that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

A career here is life-enhancing.

At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video here.

Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.

Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2026 award, for the third consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation.

At Syner-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.

For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com

Position Overview

Syner-G is seeking a Project Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of capital projects across facility expansions, infrastructure upgrades, and construction initiatives. This role is responsible for managing project scope, schedule, budget, risks, and stakeholder communication to ensure capital projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in alignment with program and organizational objectives. The Project Manager works closely with program leadership, engineering, construction teams, procurement, operations, finance, and client stakeholders to drive project execution from planning through turnover. We are actively seeking qualified candidates to join our talent pipeline for future client engagements.

WORK LOCATION:

Travel to client sites may be required based on project demands and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities

(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as necessary.)

Lead day-to-day management of capital projects, ensuring alignment with program goals, technical requirements, and client expectations.

Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocations across assigned capital initiatives.

Oversee project execution including design coordination, procurement activities, construction oversight, and commissioning support.

Manage project risks, issues, and change requests, ensuring impacts are documented, evaluated, and communicated.

Facilitate communication between internal teams, contractors, vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure timely decision-making and issue resolution.

Review design packages, technical documentation, submittals, RFIs, and construction deliverables for accuracy and compliance.

Lead project meetings, progress reviews, and coordination sessions with cross-functional teams.

Track project performance metrics including schedule adherence, cost performance, and progress against milestones.

Support procurement activities including bid evaluations, vendor coordination, and contract administration.

Ensure project activities comply with applicable codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and internal procedures.

Coordinate field activities including site walks, installation oversight, punch list development, and turnover documentation.

Prepare project reports, dashboards, and executive summaries to communicate status, risks, and key decisions.

Contribute to continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and capital program practices.

Provide guidance or oversight to junior project staff when applicable.

Qualifications And Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, project management, or a related technical field preferred.

PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification is a plus.

Technical Experience

4–9 years of experience managing or supporting capital projects, construction projects, facility upgrades, or infrastructure initiatives.

Experience working in regulated or complex environments such as biotech, pharmaceutical, industrial, or advanced manufacturing is preferred.

Strong understanding of project management processes, construction coordination, design development, and project controls.

Experience managing project schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder communication.

Experience collaborating with engineering, construction, procurement, operations, finance, and safety teams.

Experience supporting or leading project phases such as design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across diverse teams.

Proficiency with project management tools, scheduling software, and document control systems.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve technical and operational issues.

Ability to work in fast-paced environments and adapt to shifting project needs.

Ability to build strong working relationships with clients, contractors, and cross-functional partners.

Essential Functions

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of the requirements that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, including moderate noise level, an indoor temperate environment, and light levels that are bright and conducive to minimal eye strain, typical for an office environment.

Total Rewards Program

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition, and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary and annual incentive plan, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous flexible paid time off program, company-paid holidays, flexible working hours, and fully remote work options for most positions and the ability to work “almost anywhere.” However, if a physical work location is more for you, we have office locations in Greater Boston; San Diego, CA; Boulder, CO; and India.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this position is $125,000 to $150,000 yearly. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Currently, Syner-G is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Legal Statement

Syner-G is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All employment decisions, including the recruiting, hiring, placement, training availability, promotion, compensation, evaluation, disciplinary actions, and termination of employment (if necessary) are made without regard to the employee’s race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy or childbirth, personal appearance, family responsibilities, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, political affiliation, source of income, place of residence, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, physical or mental disability, or on any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Syner-G is an E-Verify employer.

jobs.description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Web Development Project Manager : Help Empower Healthcare Professionals Worldwide!

Location:
Lebanon – Remote
Employment:
Full-time
Working Hours:
10:00 am – 6:00 pm Sydney time
Compensation: Up to US$2,500 per month
depending on experience and assessment.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritize projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organized and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Meaningful perks that reflect our commitment:

Competitive salary, inclusive of a monthly retention bonus.
Remote position (work from anywhere)
, full-time, and long-term
Annual compensation review
Fitness subsidy for 12 months to support your well-being.
Birthday leave, so you can celebrate and enjoy your special day off!
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
15 days of Paid time off, ensuring team members have time to relax and recharge.
Global exposure and friendly work environment
Opportunity to learn new techniques & tools with a young and dynamic team
Lead performance with autonomy and visibility across departments.
Remote-first, collaborative culture that values initiative and outcomes.

Our Commitment

Mediboost is proudly an equal-opportunity employer.
We celebrate diversity, welcome individuality, and create a space where every voice is heard and valued.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager- Low Voltage, CCTV and Access Control
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager – Low Voltage, CCTV and Access Control based in Netherlands.

We are seeking a proactive Technical Project Manager to oversee the delivery of low-voltage infrastructure, CCTV, access control, and networking projects from initial planning through completion. In this fully remote role, you will manage technical deployments across multiple locations while ensuring quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction. You will combine project management expertise with strong technical knowledge to develop accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs), define implementation requirements, and coordinate field operations. Working closely with sales teams, technicians, vendors, and clients, you will contribute to both pre-sales technical scoping and post-sales implementation. This position offers exposure to diverse security and networking technologies within a dynamic, nationwide IT services environment. It is an opportunity to take ownership of complex technical projects while collaborating with distributed teams.

Accountabilities

As Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating technical deployments, supporting the sales process, and ensuring projects are delivered according to client specifications and operational standards.

Manage low-voltage infrastructure, CCTV, access control, and networking projects from kickoff to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and client satisfaction.
Develop accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and define technical requirements based on client specifications, floor plans, and site assessments.
Support the sales team with pre-sales technical scoping, including preparing quotes and proposals and conducting technical discovery calls.
Provide post-sales implementation support to ensure solutions are deployed effectively and meet agreed requirements.
Coordinate field technicians, vendors, and clients across multiple locations to ensure smooth project execution.
Oversee the deployment of low-voltage cabling, fiber-optic infrastructure, security systems, and network equipment.
Monitor project progress, address technical or operational challenges, and maintain clear communication with all stakeholders.
Ensure consistent implementation standards and reliable delivery across distributed project sites.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines practical knowledge of low-voltage and security infrastructure with strong project coordination skills and the ability to manage technical deployments remotely. Excellent communication is essential when working with clients, vendors, and internal teams across different time zones.

Strong technical understanding of low-voltage cabling, fiber-optic infrastructure, and physical media installation.
Hands-on knowledge and project oversight experience with CCTV installations and access control systems.
Strong experience with Ubiquiti networking and security ecosystems, including UniFi and UniFi Protect.
Experience with point-to-point (P2P) wireless bridges and outdoor wireless infrastructure, either through fieldwork or project management.
Ability to develop Bills of Materials (BOMs), interpret floor plans, assess technical requirements, and scope implementation solutions.
Experience managing multi-site or nationwide field service deployments is a strong advantage.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, vendors, and distributed teams across time zones.
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and coordination skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical projects in a fully remote environment.

Benefits

100% remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
Salary based on experience.
Opportunity to work with diverse and advanced low-voltage, physical security, and networking technologies.
Dynamic working environment involving varied technical projects and infrastructure deployments.
Opportunity to collaborate with distributed technical teams, vendors, and clients.

Syner-G is seeking a Project Manager to support the planning, coordination, and execution of facilities, engineering, maintenance, utility, and site infrastructure projects within regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and advanced manufacturing environments. This role is responsible for managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, and stakeholder communication while ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP, quality, safety, and site requirements.

The Project Manager will partner closely with Facilities, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation/CQV, EHS, Operations, Procurement, and external vendors and contractors to deliver site-based projects ranging from facility upgrades and equipment installations to infrastructure improvements, shutdowns, and operational readiness initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in an active operating environment and can successfully manage multiple concurrent projects while balancing operational priorities and business objectives.

We are actively seeking qualified candidates to join our talent pipeline for future client engagements.

WORK LOCATION

Travel to client sites may be required based on project demands and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities

(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as necessary.)

Manage multiple concurrent facilities, engineering, maintenance, and site services projects from initiation through execution, turnover, and closeout.

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, action logs, risk registers, and status reports.

Coordinate internal stakeholders, contractors, vendors, engineering partners, and consultants to support successful project delivery.

Support capital projects, facility modifications, equipment installations, renovations, utility upgrades, and infrastructure improvements.

Coordinate planned shutdowns, maintenance activities, outages, and other work requiring cross-functional site planning and execution.

Facilitate project meetings and drive timely follow-up of actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and change requests.

Support project scoping, cost estimating, procurement activities, contractor management, and project execution planning.

Partner with Facilities, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation/CQV, EHS, IT, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across project objectives.

Monitor project performance, including schedule adherence, budget performance, resource utilization, and milestone achievement.

Identify, assess, and proactively manage project risks, issues, and operational impacts while escalating concerns as appropriate.

Support commissioning, qualification, turnover, and operational handoff activities in accordance with project and site requirements.

Ensure project activities comply with applicable GMP regulations, safety standards, quality requirements, site procedures, and industry best practices.

Coordinate site field activities including site walks, contractor oversight, installation activities, punch list management, and turnover documentation.

Maintain accurate project documentation and prepare project reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for site and program leadership.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to project management processes, site services operations, and capital project execution.

Provide guidance and coordination support to junior project personnel when applicable.

Qualifications And Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Life Sciences, or a related technical field preferred.

PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification is a plus.

Experience

5+ years of project management, project engineering, or project coordination experience supporting facilities, engineering, maintenance, manufacturing, or site operations projects.

Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environments strongly preferred.

Experience managing facility upgrades, infrastructure improvements, utility projects, equipment installations, renovations, shutdowns, maintenance programs, or operational readiness initiatives.

Demonstrated experience managing contractors, vendors, project schedules, budgets, and cross-functional teams.

Familiarity with GMP-regulated environments, change control processes, commissioning, qualification, validation, and project turnover activities.

Experience supporting project lifecycle phases including planning, design, procurement, execution, commissioning, qualification, and operational handoff.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of facilities systems, site infrastructure, utilities, MEP systems, maintenance and reliability programs, and manufacturing support systems.

Excellent project planning, organizational, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing project demands within a dynamic operating environment.

Proficiency with project management tools, scheduling software, and document management systems.

Ability to collaborate effectively with operations, engineering, quality, safety, maintenance, and leadership teams.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety, compliance, and quality standards.

Ability to build and maintain productive relationships with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting the following project types is highly desirable:

Site services and facilities operations

Facility renovations and expansions

Utility and infrastructure upgrades

Equipment installations and relocations

Laboratory and manufacturing facility projects

Maintenance and reliability improvement programs

Planned shutdowns and outage management

Commissioning, qualification, and turnover activities

Operational readiness and startup initiatives

GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities

Essential Functions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, including moderate noise level, an indoor temperate environment, and light levels that are bright and conducive to minimal eye strain, typical for an office environment.

Total Rewards Program

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition, and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary and annual incentive plan, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous flexible paid time off program, company-paid holidays, flexible working hours, and fully remote work options for most positions and the ability to work “almost anywhere.” However, if a physical work location is more for you, we have office locations in Greater Boston; San Diego, CA; Boulder, CO; and India.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this position is $125,000 to $135,000 yearly. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Under the general direction of the Director, Health Major Capital Sr. Project Manager (Sr. PM) is accountable for project management services to ensure design and construction projects are on schedule, within budget, high-quality, cost-effective, and appropriate to client program needs. Simultaneously manages multiple projects of various sizes in the challenging healthcare construction environment.Services include all elements of project management from concept through project closeout including initial scoping, budgeting, funding, procurement, construction management and closeout of large and small projects.

The Sr. PM organizes, plans, and controls the design and construction efforts on projects ranging from $50,000 - $500,000,000.This involves selecting professional design staff (architects and engineers), general contractors and subcontractors, coordinating the activities of clients, construction inspectors, and others associated with the projects; managing project progress to achieve overall project objectives consistent with department standards and in alignment with customer expectations including, budget, cost and quality; resolving problems that arise in the projects; working with state agency officials to ensure compliance and safety.The project manager has a first line responsibility to communicate effectively with project stakeholders regarding program, budget, schedule, and construction impact.The Sr. PM utilizes internal project management tools and systems to monitor progress, control schedules and budgets, generate timely reports, and maintain comprehensive records throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure accurate data entry and updates to support transparent communication, audit readiness, and informed decision-making. Sr. PM provides support to the annual Capital Budget development process. Project managers may be responsible for coordinating the activities of other Project Managers and Assistant Project Managers as directed.

Represents UCSF Health on design and construction projects, including new development, facility expansion, renovations and retrofitting. Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and reporting on all design and construction activities. Administrate consultant and construction agreements, facilitate quality control, maintenance of design and construction schedules, construction management and owner representative responsibilities. Manage medium-to-large teams of external vendors and internal affiliate and service line staff on medium-to-large projects. Demonstrate a mastery of project management, works with a high degree of autonomy, and is responsible for delivering medium to large scale projects with moderate to difficult complexity. Responsible for delivering projects on time and on budget. Exercises independent judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

Sr. PM leads developmental stage of capital projects to assure that project scope, schedule, and phasing are adequately defined. Use Major Capital project benchmarks and/or work with the design professionals to create the preliminary project budget and schedule.

Sr. PM defines working criteria for a proposed project, determining the hazardous materials, infection control, phasing of work, and fire and life safety requirements that are necessary.Estimate the design review efforts for a project to assure that the quality of the construction documents is sufficient to minimize the risk of cost overruns during construction.

Sr. PM coordinates the efforts of the Inspector of Record, state agencies (e.g., CDPH), the contractor and University representatives to ensure code compliance and quality of work, and a constructive relationship with the regulators. Prepare and verify that all required documentation is completed prior to occupancy or authorized approval of a project.

Sr. PM coordinates all project relocations, furniture, equipment and IT scopes of work, which may be supported by other internal UCSF Real Estate resources. Sr. PM is responsible to assure that all aspects of the project are addressed in a timely manner.

Skills

Develop and maintain project schedules, resources and budgets.
Maintain project schedule and budget projections for monthly cash flow reports.
Develop, execute and monitor vendor contracts.
Manage project risks associated with schedule, scope and budget.
Review and approve invoices, including pay applications for accuracy and completeness.
Develop, monitoring and completion of project closeout strategy.
Maintain a strong team culture of accountability and integrity on the projects they manage.
Identify gaps and work with supervisors to correct.
Implement LEAN processes to ensure reliability in projects.
Develop and maintain strong working relationships with affiliate representatives, management and other departments within UCSF.
Ensure their teams maintain a culture of high collaboration, accountability, trust and integrity.
Collaborate effectively with other Real Estate staff including but not limited to Assistant PMs, Project Manager Assistants, architects, signage and wayfinding manager, FFE coordinator, etc.

Position will work at all UCSF Health locations in San Francisco Bay Area including new off-campus lease sites. All Real Estate staff are required to be on-site, in-person, no less than 4 full days per week, although project activities may require beyond that requirement. The PM is required to be responsive to the project needs and demands based on the phases of the project and construction activities.

Department Overview

The organization of UCSF Real Estate is focused on the development, planning, delivery, and management of physical space for UCSF. Key responsibilities include a unified approach to oversee the active UCSF growth planned on a multi-site campus and to manage the complex metropolitan environments affecting capital assets and projects and efforts to align municipal challenges with maximum effectiveness in support of the UCSF mission.

UCSF Real Estate is an integrated unit that enables the alignment of development, planning, design, construction, and management of facilities and a lease portfolio of 1 million square feet across UCSF.Services are provided through the following departments:Building Permit Services, Campus Design and Construction, Campus Planning, Construction Contract Administration, Health Design and Construction, Health Major Capital Projects, Real Estate Services, Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland Capital Program Management and support through Business Intelligence, and Finance, Administration and Operations.

The Major Capital Project Department is responsible for delivering the design and construction of new buildings and other major capital projects as assigned. Typical project budgets are hundreds of millions of dollars. Our goals are delivered through Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) methodologies. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is continuing to grow our teams with the best talent. This role is completely remote friendly within the United States. If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations (San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York City & Chicago) our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like.

Reddit is a network of thousands of communities where over 100 million daily active users dive into their interests, hobbies, and passions. Core to scaling our ads, and consumer experiences is high-quality, continuous data annotation. Our Operations ecosystem is expanding its central labeling engine to power models, taxonomies, and product experiments across both our Ads and Consumer Product organizations.

We are seeking a Staff Operations Program Manager (IC5)
to serve as the strategic architect and operations lead for Reddit's central data labeling function. In this high-visibility, 0-to-1 role, you will engage directly with product and technical teams across the company at all levels, to determine requirements and how best to execute these via our centralised function.

You will excel at translating complex, unstructured product needs into clear, scalable labeling directives that can be seamlessly executed by vendor teams and you will partner with our vendor partners to scale and optimize our delivery model. In parallel, you will partner with cross functional leaders to define the future of automated, LLM-based labeling - positioning Reddit to leverage best in class technology and operations efficiencies.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Intake & Expectation Management:
Strategic Intake & Expectation Management: Own and scale the incoming request process across Consumer and Ads. Ensure delivery frameworks are robust and reliable, and that all initiatives are prioritised appropriately, based on agreed criteria and business impact.
0-to-1 Operations & LLM Scaling:
Take full ownership of shaping how the central labeling function grows; design and execute the operational roadmap to integrate LLM-assisted labeling workflows to augment human vendors and multiply throughput.
Taxonomy & Experimentation Architecture:
Standardize taxonomy definition guidelines and operationalize complex, multi-quarter labeling projects supporting Consumer Org product experiments and Ads Org safety systems.
Cross-Functional Alignment:
Partner directly with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Ops Leaders across orgs to align labeling capabilities with broader business objectives, translating high-level concepts into executable human and machine tasks.
Guideline & Operational Calibration:
Partner with our dedicated Vendor Manager to hand off clear task guidelines, resolve complex edge cases, and establish feedback loops that ensure task performance aligns with product expectations.
Framework Development:
Build, document, and standardize centralized request intake models, SLA frameworks, quality assurance practices, and throughput metrics across all labeling domains.

Required Qualifications:

7+ years
of experience in data operations, program management, or vendor operations with a heavy focus on data labeling, model training data, or taxonomy infrastructure.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership:
Proven ability to align Product and Engineering leadership, skilled at setting firm boundaries, and enforcing structured prioritization.
Translation & Taxonomy Mastery:
Exceptional ability to translate vague product requirements into detailed, unambiguous labeling instructions, edge-case trees, and taxonomy classification schemas.
LLM & Automation Integration:
Experience leveraging LLMs, synthetic data generation, or automated tooling to augment traditional vendor annotation workflows and scale operational capacity.
Operational Collaboration:
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with internal Vendor Operations/Managers to translate project requirements into executable guidelines and handle task-level escalations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience navigating cross-functional dynamics across both Ads/Monetization and Consumer-facing product organizations.
Strong proficiency in SQL and data manipulation to independently analyze vendor quality metrics, pipeline throughput, and project completion SLAs.

jobs.title: Claims Program Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Claims Program Manager based in the United States.

As a Claims Program Manager, you will oversee claims operations and strengthen relationships with third-party administrators (TPAs), managing general underwriters (MGUs), and other business partners within a specialty insurance environment. You will lead and support a team of Program Management Specialists responsible for managing a diverse portfolio of claims clients. Your role will combine relationship management, operational oversight, risk assessment, and performance analysis to ensure claims are handled efficiently and in accordance with policy terms and regulatory requirements. Working closely with internal teams across Underwriting, Actuarial, Compliance, Legal, and IT, you will identify operational challenges and drive practical improvements. You will also contribute to team development, process documentation, and the delivery of consistent, high-quality service. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on client partnerships and claims performance across a growing specialty insurance portfolio.

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

In this role, you will oversee program claims activities, support the development of the Program Management team, and ensure strong operational relationships with administrators and business partners. Your responsibilities will include:

Relationship Management
Schedule, coordinate, and monitor annual client audits, acting as the primary audit coordinator.
Review reports prepared by Program Management team members and provide first-level quality assurance.
Oversee team members managing a diverse portfolio of products, administrators, and client relationships.
Support a relationship-based service culture through regular engagement with clients and internal stakeholders.
Act as a liaison between administrative, operational, and underwriting teams to resolve ongoing issues.
Address sensitive or challenging customer situations professionally and constructively.
Participate in team members' client meetings and ensure open issues are addressed at least monthly.
Coordinate with IT to investigate and resolve technical or system-related issues.
Assign or support the onboarding of new clients and administrative partners.
Build long-term customer relationships through responsive and professional service.

Risk Management
Support due diligence for prospective program administration partners, including onsite reviews and operational assessments.
Participate in annual administrator reviews to verify compliance with company requirements and identify process gaps or improvement opportunities.
Monitor claims activity at least quarterly to identify unusual trends or outliers.
Identify processing, system, and operational issues affecting client or internal operations.
Help ensure claims are processed and paid consistently with applicable policy terms.

Reporting and Trend Analysis
Prepare monthly reporting packages for senior management, including claims inventory, TPA customer service and turnaround statistics, and referral analysis.
Analyze claims-related litigation and regulatory inquiries monthly to identify trends and potential exposure.
Review claims referral logs at least quarterly and provide recommendations for potential adjustments to authority levels.

Legal and Regulatory Coordination
Refer small claims litigation matters to the Legal team and provide assistance as needed.
Review attorney correspondence and coordinate appropriate responses with administrators.
Support the Compliance team in reviewing claims-related regulatory inquiries.

Best Practices and Process Documentation
Draft and maintain internal Claims Best Practices documentation covering company and regulatory standards, procedures, and workflows.
Review and update documentation at least quarterly.
Oversee the Program Management team's review of TPA best practices.
Ensure claims administrators understand and follow applicable state unfair claims settlement practices laws.

Training and Development
Continue developing the team's knowledge of relevant insurance products and claims processes.
Help team members adopt a broader operational perspective beyond traditional claims auditing.
Use real-world situations, including challenges involving administrators, as opportunities for coaching and professional development.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines specialty insurance claims experience with strong analytical, organizational, and relationship management skills. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, resolving complex operational issues, and communicating effectively with clients and internal teams. Required qualifications include:

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or equivalent professional experience.
At least 6 years of relevant experience in Special Risk, Travel, and Travel Medical insurance.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Proven ability to build strong working relationships with customers, administrators, and colleagues.
Demonstrated commitment to high-quality service delivery, customer satisfaction, and effective issue resolution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify operational trends and implement process improvements.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information clearly.
High level of personal accountability and commitment to continuous improvement.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20%.

Preferred Experience

Experience with specialty insurance products such as Employer Stop Loss, Travel, Short-Term Medical, Medical Travel, Workers' Compensation, and/or Occupational Accident.

Benefits

Annual base salary: $61,600–$115,700, depending on location, experience, skills, responsibilities, and performance.
Potential eligibility for discretionary equity-based compensation and/or performance-based variable pay.
Competitive compensation package.
401(k) plan with generous employer matching contributions.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan with employer matching.
Generous paid time off.
Comprehensive benefits covering health, dental, and vision, alongside programs supporting physical, mental, and financial well-being for employees and their families.
Tuition reimbursement.
Support for industry-related certifications and professional training.
Career development opportunities and resources to support long-term professional growth.
Matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and employee-led corporate giving initiatives.
Dynamic, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.
Remote work opportunity.

jobs.title: Program Manager – Infrastructure & Operations Portfolio
jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown
is seeking a Program Manager – Infrastructure & Operations Portfolio
to join our growing team in Daytona Beach, FL; Plano, TX or Remote
for the right candidate.

The Program Manager for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) is responsible for the planning, governance, and execution of a portfolio of enterprise technology initiatives that modernize, stabilize, and enhance the organization's infrastructure and operational capabilities. This role oversees programs spanning cloud services, networking, end-user computing, IT service management, and operational excellence, ensuring initiatives are aligned with business priorities, technology strategy, and operational objectives.

This role leads and develops a team of Project Managers, providing strategic direction, governance, coaching, and escalation support to ensure consistent execution and delivery across the I&O portfolio. In addition to portfolio and people leadership responsibilities, this role directly manages complex, high-impact infrastructure and operations initiatives that are critical to the organization's technology strategy and operational objectives.

How You Will Contribute:

Portfolio & Program Leadership

Own and manage the Infrastructure & Operations project portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, technology roadmaps, operational priorities, and resource capacity.
Lead large-scale programs and transformations, including cloud adoption, data center modernization, network transformation, endpoint management, disaster recovery, operational resilience, and ITSM initiatives.
Partner with leadership to assess portfolio capacity, resource allocation, and delivery priorities across Infrastructure & Operations initiatives
Establish portfolio governance, executive reporting, and decision-making frameworks to monitor progress, risks, budgets, and delivery outcomes.
Monitor portfolio financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, capital expenditures, and operational spending
Drive cross-functional alignment and facilitate escalation resolution to maintain program momentum and achieve strategic objectives.

Leadership of Project Managers

Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Project Managers supporting Infrastructure & Operations initiatives.
Provide direction, guidance, and escalation support to ensure successful project execution and delivery.
Promote consistent application of PMO methodologies, governance practices, reporting standards, and project management disciplines.
Conduct regular portfolio and project reviews to assess performance, resource needs, risks, and dependencies.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery of excellence.

Project & Program Delivery

Directly lead complex Infrastructure & Operations projects and programs, including cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, network transformation, disaster recovery, endpoint management, and ITSM initiatives, through the full project lifecycle.
Define project scope, objectives, success criteria, milestones, budgets, resource requirements, and delivery plans in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project plans, RAID logs, communication plans, executive status reports, and other project governance artifacts for assigned initiatives.
Provide delivery of leadership and oversight for projects managed by other Project Managers, ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, governance standards, and organizational objectives.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to manage dependencies, mitigate risks, resolve issues, and drive successful outcomes.
Evaluate trade-offs between cost, complexity, operational impact, risk, and business value to support effective decision-making.
Ensure initiatives are delivered in accordance with enterprise architecture, security requirements, operational standards, and service-level objectives.

Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration

Partner with technology, business, finance, security, compliance, and operations leaders to align initiatives with organizational objectives.
Build strong stakeholder relationships and provide clear executive communication regarding portfolio health, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
Support portfolio planning, budgeting, forecasting, and governance activities across Infrastructure & Operations.

Risk, Compliance & Change Management

Identify and mitigate risks related to operational stability, security, compliance, and technology delivery.
Ensure programs adhere to governance standards, change management processes, and operational policies.
Serve as the escalation point for portfolio-level risks, issues, and cross-functional conflicts.
Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit teams to support regulatory and governance requirements.

Operational Readiness & Transition

Ensure infrastructure solutions are successfully transitioned into operational support through documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.
Validate operational readiness, including support models, monitoring, service management processes, and recovery procedures.
Coordinate transition activities with Engineering, Operations, and Service Desk teams to ensure service continuity and adoption.
Conduct post-implementation reviews and incorporate lessons learned into future initiatives.

Required

Skills & Experience to be Successful:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or related field.
8+ years of experience in IT program or portfolio management, including experience leading Infrastructure & Operations initiatives.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, programs, or portfolios with cross-functional dependencies.
Experience leading, mentoring, or developing Project Managers and delivery teams.
Working knowledge of infrastructure and operations disciplines, including cloud services, networking, compute, storage, endpoint management, IT service management, and operational support models.
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
Experience with portfolio governance, executive reporting, budgeting, and resource planning.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in complex, fast-paced environments.

Preferred

Experience leading enterprise infrastructure transformation or modernization programs.
PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PMI-ACP, or similar project, program, or portfolio management certification.
ITIL certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned environments.
Experience with Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
Experience with portfolio management (PPM) tools and enterprise governance frameworks.
Experience supporting organizations undergoing significant technology or operational transformation.

Pay Range

140,000.00 - 140,000.00 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and exceptionally strong communicator
to manage and coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives within a Digital Supply Chain Platform for our client.
The Project Manager will work closely with Business Product Owners, Business Users, Release Train Engineers (RTEs), and technology delivery teams to ensure seamless planning, execution, deployment, and stakeholder communication across the platform.
The role requires someone who can connect the dots across multiple workstreams, proactively identify risks and dependencies, drive accountability, and provide clear visibility into overall platform progress.

Strong business communication, stakeholder engagement and the ability to independently drive initiatives are critical success factors for this role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integrated Project & Deployment Planning

Develop and maintain an integrated project and deployment roadmap covering multiple concurrent initiatives, enhancements, and releases.
Collaborate with Business Product Owners, RTEs, and delivery teams to align priorities, milestones, release schedules, and dependencies.
Track project progress against committed timelines and proactively identify potential delays or conflicts.
Coordinate release readiness activities, business validations, and deployment communications.
Ensure alignment between individual project plans and the broader platform roadmap.

2. Project Governance, Risks & Issues

Establish and maintain structured tracking of project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items.
Proactively follow up with stakeholders to drive resolution of open items and remove execution bottlenecks.
Facilitate regular project reviews and governance meetings with business and technology stakeholders.
Escalate critical risks, delays, and decisions to appropriate stakeholders with clear recommendations.
Drive accountability and timely closure of commitments across teams.

3. Business Stakeholder Management

Serve as a central coordination point between Business Product Owners, business users, RTEs, and delivery teams.
Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across different business functions and organizational levels.
Facilitate discussions to clarify priorities, business expectations, and delivery commitments.
Translate project progress, technical updates, and delivery challenges into clear, business-friendly communication.
Ensure business stakeholders remain informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.

4. Status Reporting & Leadership Communication

Prepare consolidated weekly and monthly platform status reports covering accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, issues, and key decisions.
Develop executive-level dashboards, presentations, and updates highlighting overall platform health and delivery progress.
Communicate project achievements, business impact, and upcoming releases in a concise and compelling manner.
Provide leadership with actionable insights rather than simply reporting activities.
Maintain consistency, accuracy, and transparency across all project communications.

5. Platform Communication, Engagement & Adoption

Own and execute the platform communication and stakeholder engagement plan.

Plan, coordinate, and facilitate monthly webinars showcasing platform capabilities, recent enhancements, upcoming releases, and business value.
Organize business roadshows, platform demonstrations, and stakeholder engagement sessions.
Develop newsletters, internal articles, release announcements, success stories, and other communication materials.
Partner with Product Owners and business teams to highlight platform achievements, adoption, and measurable business benefits.
Ensure communications are engaging, professionally presented, and tailored to different audiences.
Gather stakeholder feedback and identify opportunities to improve platform awareness and adoption.

6. Continuous Improvement & Execution Excellence

Establish standardized templates and processes for planning, reporting, governance, and communication.
Identify opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration, delivery predictability, and stakeholder engagement.
Drive follow-through on decisions and commitments with minimal supervision.
Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, and proactive communication.

Required Qualifications & Experience

12-15 years of experience in Project Management, Program Coordination, or PMO roles within the IT industry.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects or workstreams in a complex business and technology environment.
Experience working with Business Product Owners, business stakeholders, Agile delivery teams, and Release Train Engineers.
Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe delivery practices, release planning, and cross-team dependency management.
Demonstrated ability to maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, executive status reports, and stakeholder communication plans.
Experience creating professional presentations, newsletters, webinar content, and business communications.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and project tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
Exposure to supply chain platforms, enterprise applications, or digital transformation programs is strongly preferred.

Critical Competencies – Must Have

1. Exceptional Communication Skills

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are mandatory. The candidate must be able to articulate complex information clearly, create compelling presentations, confidently facilitate meetings, and communicate effectively with both business users and senior leadership.
2. Strong Ownership & Follow-Through

Must demonstrate the ability to independently drive activities, proactively follow up with stakeholders, challenge delays constructively, and ensure commitments are delivered.
3. Stakeholder Management & Influence

Ability to work across teams and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority.
4. Planning & Organizational Excellence

Strong ability to manage competing priorities, maintain integrated plans, and coordinate multiple moving pieces without losing sight of overall objectives.
5. Business Orientation

Ability to understand business priorities, communicate platform value, and connect project outcomes to business benefits.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting digital supply chain, logistics, planning, inventory management, or enterprise transformation platforms.
Prior experience in a large multinational organization with distributed business and technology teams.
Exposure to platform adoption, change management, or internal communication campaigns.
PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent project management certification is a plus.

Key Deliverables

Integrated Platform Project & Deployment Roadmap
Consolidated Project Status Dashboard and Executive Reporting
Centralized RAID and Cross-Project Dependency Tracker
Release Readiness and Deployment Communication Plan
Monthly Platform Webinar and Presentation Materials
Business Roadshow and Stakeholder Engagement Calendar
Platform Newsletters, Articles, and Success Stories
Stakeholder Communication and Engagement Plan

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will bring structure, predictability, and visibility to a portfolio of concurrent digital supply chain initiatives while ensuring that business stakeholders remain informed, engaged, and confident in the platform's progress.
This is not simply a project tracking role.

We are looking for someone who can drive execution, connect stakeholders, communicate with impact, and create a strong professional presence for the Digital Supply Chain Platform across the organization.

Position Summary

The ASIC Program Manager is responsible for leading complex ASIC development programs from concept through silicon production. This role drives cross-functional execution across architecture, digital and analog design, verification, physical design, CAD, product engineering, packaging, foundry, and operations teams to achieve program objectives related to schedule, cost, quality, and commitments. In addition the candidate will be supporting various communication and coordination functions for the ASIC organization and occasionally, cross-functional organizations.

The successful candidate combines strong technical understanding of semiconductor and ASIC development with exceptional program management, leadership, communication, and risk management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

Program Leadership

Lead end-to-end ASIC development programs from planning through production release while developing and maintaining integrated program schedules covering all major development milestones.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and decision-making processes across functional teams and facilitate alignment and issue resolution in a timely manner.

Schedule and Milestone Management

Build and manage program plans for from architectural specifications to conclusion of validation and qualification of the ASIC project and track critical path tasks and cross-functional dependencies.
Monitor milestone progress, achievements and forecast program outcomes.

Risk and Issue Management

Lead risk identification, assessment, mitigation, and escalation activities to drive rapid resolution of technical, schedule, resource, and dependency issues.
Conduct regular program health reviews, track and drive all issues that arise to resolution.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner closely with ASIC project engineering leaders and all cross-functional teams to understand critical deliverables between all teams and timelines associated with development and release. Continuously monitor and track the deliverables and all issues that arise that could potentially cause delays.

Drive operational cadence: Executive Monthly Reviews, ASIC WW all hands, agenda/material prep, knowledge sharing, and action item closure
Continuous improvements: identify areas for improvement between HW, SDK, SW and other cross-functional teams, propose solutions and drive implementation
ASIC Resources: Support org structure, headcount planning, and hiring prioritization for engineering teams by working with hiring managers and staffing support teams

Project Milestone Management

As critical development milestones are approaching, ensure that all relevant checklists and reviews occur in advance of achieving the milestone event. Drive actions that arise from the checklists and reviews to closure so that tapeout occurs on or before the target date.

Process Improvement

Continuous process program management improvements leveraging AI, methodologies and reporting of development metrics will be essential to keep up with the tremendous challenges that are faced to achieve execution predictability and implementation of best practices associated with risk mitigation, cross functional alignment and overall ASIC and DSP development processes.

Required Qualifications

KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
8+ years of semiconductor industry experience.
5+ years of program or project management experience leading ASIC or SoC development programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering successful tapeouts from concept through production.
Strong understanding of ASIC development lifecycles and semiconductor product development processes.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration.
PMP certification or equivalent program management certification.
Experience with advanced process nodes such as 3nm, 2nm and beyond
Experience managing external vendors, foundries, and IP suppliers.
Understanding of AI, networking, wireless, data center, or telecom ASIC products.

Program Management Skills:

Program planning

jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Global Patient Safety (GPS) Project Manager

Position Summary

As the GPS Project Manager, you will serve as the project lead responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering the Lilly Global Safety System (LGSS) program to support the broader GPS business strategy.

In this role, you will partner closely with business, IT, Quality, and Tech@Lilly stakeholders to enable the development, implementation, and support of a compliant, reliable, and scalable program solution. This role also engages with external parties, including vendors and partners, to advance Lilly's ability to capture, process, and report adverse event data in accordance with global regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Define, lead, and execute implementation plans for the LGSS program across multiple workstreams, including organizational change management, validation, and data migration.

Drive and manage key deliverables and program milestones, monitoring progress to enable clear, data-driven decision making.

Identify, monitor, and communicate project needs to appropriate stakeholders.

Lead planning ceremonies, risk and dependency management, and issue escalation across cross-functional teams supporting the program.

Provide progress reports and program metrics to leadership, process owners, and end users.

Manage vendor relationships and deliverables related to LGSS, including scope, timelines, quality, and performance against contractual commitments.

Provide project management best practices, communication guidance, and support across the program.

Coordinate and support testing and validation activities to ensure audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

Understand GPS business strategies, processes, and technology as they relate to global patient safety and adverse event reporting.

Actively participate in shared learning across the team; coach and train others as needed to ensure effective execution of program processes.

Manage and govern cross dependencies of all other upstream and downstream implementations that impact LGSS.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree

Experience leading large, multi-year projects or programs

Experience leading a program implementation in a regulated environment

Knowledge of regulatory and quality requirements

Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and influencing cross-functional teams and stakeholders

Demonstrated experience in management and leadership of multiple large-scale programs

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced knowledge of project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project and/or Critical Chain).

Strong strategic thinking, collaboration and coordination skills to effectively plan and deliver

Project management certification, education, or training (e.g., PMP, Scrum Master, Six Sigma Black/Green Belt)

Critical Chain

Experience with pharmacovigilance or adverse event reporting systems (e.g., Argus, Veeva Safety)

Multi-vendor and Supplier Management experience

Good interpersonal and leadership skills

Demonstrated track record of successful execution of complex Programs and initiatives

Flexibility in approach; able to adjust to unexpected risks
