new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and exceptionally strong communicator
to manage and coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives within a Digital Supply Chain Platform for our client.
The Project Manager will work closely with Business Product Owners, Business Users, Release Train Engineers (RTEs), and technology delivery teams to ensure seamless planning, execution, deployment, and stakeholder communication across the platform.
The role requires someone who can connect the dots across multiple workstreams, proactively identify risks and dependencies, drive accountability, and provide clear visibility into overall platform progress.

Strong business communication, stakeholder engagement and the ability to independently drive initiatives are critical success factors for this role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integrated Project & Deployment Planning

Develop and maintain an integrated project and deployment roadmap covering multiple concurrent initiatives, enhancements, and releases.
Collaborate with Business Product Owners, RTEs, and delivery teams to align priorities, milestones, release schedules, and dependencies.
Track project progress against committed timelines and proactively identify potential delays or conflicts.
Coordinate release readiness activities, business validations, and deployment communications.
Ensure alignment between individual project plans and the broader platform roadmap.

2. Project Governance, Risks & Issues

Establish and maintain structured tracking of project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items.
Proactively follow up with stakeholders to drive resolution of open items and remove execution bottlenecks.
Facilitate regular project reviews and governance meetings with business and technology stakeholders.
Escalate critical risks, delays, and decisions to appropriate stakeholders with clear recommendations.
Drive accountability and timely closure of commitments across teams.

3. Business Stakeholder Management

Serve as a central coordination point between Business Product Owners, business users, RTEs, and delivery teams.
Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across different business functions and organizational levels.
Facilitate discussions to clarify priorities, business expectations, and delivery commitments.
Translate project progress, technical updates, and delivery challenges into clear, business-friendly communication.
Ensure business stakeholders remain informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.

4. Status Reporting & Leadership Communication

Prepare consolidated weekly and monthly platform status reports covering accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, issues, and key decisions.
Develop executive-level dashboards, presentations, and updates highlighting overall platform health and delivery progress.
Communicate project achievements, business impact, and upcoming releases in a concise and compelling manner.
Provide leadership with actionable insights rather than simply reporting activities.
Maintain consistency, accuracy, and transparency across all project communications.

5. Platform Communication, Engagement & Adoption

Own and execute the platform communication and stakeholder engagement plan.

Plan, coordinate, and facilitate monthly webinars showcasing platform capabilities, recent enhancements, upcoming releases, and business value.
Organize business roadshows, platform demonstrations, and stakeholder engagement sessions.
Develop newsletters, internal articles, release announcements, success stories, and other communication materials.
Partner with Product Owners and business teams to highlight platform achievements, adoption, and measurable business benefits.
Ensure communications are engaging, professionally presented, and tailored to different audiences.
Gather stakeholder feedback and identify opportunities to improve platform awareness and adoption.

6. Continuous Improvement & Execution Excellence

Establish standardized templates and processes for planning, reporting, governance, and communication.
Identify opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration, delivery predictability, and stakeholder engagement.
Drive follow-through on decisions and commitments with minimal supervision.
Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, and proactive communication.

Required Qualifications & Experience

12-15 years of experience in Project Management, Program Coordination, or PMO roles within the IT industry.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects or workstreams in a complex business and technology environment.
Experience working with Business Product Owners, business stakeholders, Agile delivery teams, and Release Train Engineers.
Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe delivery practices, release planning, and cross-team dependency management.
Demonstrated ability to maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, executive status reports, and stakeholder communication plans.
Experience creating professional presentations, newsletters, webinar content, and business communications.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and project tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
Exposure to supply chain platforms, enterprise applications, or digital transformation programs is strongly preferred.

Critical Competencies – Must Have

1. Exceptional Communication Skills

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are mandatory. The candidate must be able to articulate complex information clearly, create compelling presentations, confidently facilitate meetings, and communicate effectively with both business users and senior leadership.
2. Strong Ownership & Follow-Through

Must demonstrate the ability to independently drive activities, proactively follow up with stakeholders, challenge delays constructively, and ensure commitments are delivered.
3. Stakeholder Management & Influence

Ability to work across teams and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority.
4. Planning & Organizational Excellence

Strong ability to manage competing priorities, maintain integrated plans, and coordinate multiple moving pieces without losing sight of overall objectives.
5. Business Orientation

Ability to understand business priorities, communicate platform value, and connect project outcomes to business benefits.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting digital supply chain, logistics, planning, inventory management, or enterprise transformation platforms.
Prior experience in a large multinational organization with distributed business and technology teams.
Exposure to platform adoption, change management, or internal communication campaigns.
PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent project management certification is a plus.

Key Deliverables

Integrated Platform Project & Deployment Roadmap
Consolidated Project Status Dashboard and Executive Reporting
Centralized RAID and Cross-Project Dependency Tracker
Release Readiness and Deployment Communication Plan
Monthly Platform Webinar and Presentation Materials
Business Roadshow and Stakeholder Engagement Calendar
Platform Newsletters, Articles, and Success Stories
Stakeholder Communication and Engagement Plan

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will bring structure, predictability, and visibility to a portfolio of concurrent digital supply chain initiatives while ensuring that business stakeholders remain informed, engaged, and confident in the platform's progress.
This is not simply a project tracking role.

We are looking for someone who can drive execution, connect stakeholders, communicate with impact, and create a strong professional presence for the Digital Supply Chain Platform across the organization.

Birmingham Children's Trust,

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how partners work together to provide earlier, more effective and joined-up help for children and families across Birmingham.

As part of the national reforms to Children’s Social Care, Birmingham is developing new approaches to Family Help and Multi-Agency Child Protection. At the heart of this is our ambition to strengthen Early Help and build a joined-up partnership offer within our districts, making it easier for families to get the right help, from the right people, at the right time.

Our work is focused on three shared priorities:

Keeping Families Together
Improved Education Attendance
Good Early Years Child Development

Join us

Passionate about improving outcomes for children and families
Collaborative and able to work across organisational boundaries
Confident at building relationships and bringing people together
Able to turn ideas into practical and sustainable ways of working
Curious, adaptable and willing to test, learn and improve

new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The ASIC Program Manager is responsible for leading complex ASIC development programs from concept through silicon production. This role drives cross-functional execution across architecture, digital and analog design, verification, physical design, CAD, product engineering, packaging, foundry, and operations teams to achieve program objectives related to schedule, cost, quality, and commitments. In addition the candidate will be supporting various communication and coordination functions for the ASIC organization and occasionally, cross-functional organizations.

The successful candidate combines strong technical understanding of semiconductor and ASIC development with exceptional program management, leadership, communication, and risk management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

Program Leadership

Lead end-to-end ASIC development programs from planning through production release while developing and maintaining integrated program schedules covering all major development milestones.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and decision-making processes across functional teams and facilitate alignment and issue resolution in a timely manner.

Schedule and Milestone Management

Build and manage program plans for from architectural specifications to conclusion of validation and qualification of the ASIC project and track critical path tasks and cross-functional dependencies.
Monitor milestone progress, achievements and forecast program outcomes.

Risk and Issue Management

Lead risk identification, assessment, mitigation, and escalation activities to drive rapid resolution of technical, schedule, resource, and dependency issues.
Conduct regular program health reviews, track and drive all issues that arise to resolution.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner closely with ASIC project engineering leaders and all cross-functional teams to understand critical deliverables between all teams and timelines associated with development and release. Continuously monitor and track the deliverables and all issues that arise that could potentially cause delays.

Drive operational cadence: Executive Monthly Reviews, ASIC WW all hands, agenda/material prep, knowledge sharing, and action item closure
Continuous improvements: identify areas for improvement between HW, SDK, SW and other cross-functional teams, propose solutions and drive implementation
ASIC Resources: Support org structure, headcount planning, and hiring prioritization for engineering teams by working with hiring managers and staffing support teams

Project Milestone Management

As critical development milestones are approaching, ensure that all relevant checklists and reviews occur in advance of achieving the milestone event. Drive actions that arise from the checklists and reviews to closure so that tapeout occurs on or before the target date.

Process Improvement

Continuous process program management improvements leveraging AI, methodologies and reporting of development metrics will be essential to keep up with the tremendous challenges that are faced to achieve execution predictability and implementation of best practices associated with risk mitigation, cross functional alignment and overall ASIC and DSP development processes.

Required Qualifications

KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
8+ years of semiconductor industry experience.
5+ years of program or project management experience leading ASIC or SoC development programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering successful tapeouts from concept through production.
Strong understanding of ASIC development lifecycles and semiconductor product development processes.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration.
PMP certification or equivalent program management certification.
Experience with advanced process nodes such as 3nm, 2nm and beyond
Experience managing external vendors, foundries, and IP suppliers.
Understanding of AI, networking, wireless, data center, or telecom ASIC products.

Program Management Skills:

Program planning
Critical path analysis
Risk management
Dependency management
Executive communication
Stakeholder management
Financial and resource planning
Escalation management
Data-driven decision making

ASIC/SoC development lifecycle
Digital and analog design methodologies
Design verification
DFT and test methodologies
Physical implementation flows
Timing closure

Silicon validation
Product qualification
Semiconductor manufacturing processes

Leadership Competencies:

Strategic thinking

Technical judgment
Bias for action
Collaboration and influence
Clear communication
Problem solving
Ownership and accountability
Continuous improvement mindset

This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Global Patient Safety (GPS) Project Manager

Position Summary

As the GPS Project Manager, you will serve as the project lead responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering the Lilly Global Safety System (LGSS) program to support the broader GPS business strategy.

In this role, you will partner closely with business, IT, Quality, and Tech@Lilly stakeholders to enable the development, implementation, and support of a compliant, reliable, and scalable program solution. This role also engages with external parties, including vendors and partners, to advance Lilly's ability to capture, process, and report adverse event data in accordance with global regulatory requirements.

Define, lead, and execute implementation plans for the LGSS program across multiple workstreams, including organizational change management, validation, and data migration.

Drive and manage key deliverables and program milestones, monitoring progress to enable clear, data-driven decision making.

Identify, monitor, and communicate project needs to appropriate stakeholders.

Lead planning ceremonies, risk and dependency management, and issue escalation across cross-functional teams supporting the program.

Provide progress reports and program metrics to leadership, process owners, and end users.

Manage vendor relationships and deliverables related to LGSS, including scope, timelines, quality, and performance against contractual commitments.

Provide project management best practices, communication guidance, and support across the program.

Coordinate and support testing and validation activities to ensure audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

Understand GPS business strategies, processes, and technology as they relate to global patient safety and adverse event reporting.

Actively participate in shared learning across the team; coach and train others as needed to ensure effective execution of program processes.

Manage and govern cross dependencies of all other upstream and downstream implementations that impact LGSS.

Bachelor's degree

Experience leading large, multi-year projects or programs

Experience leading a program implementation in a regulated environment

Knowledge of regulatory and quality requirements

Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and influencing cross-functional teams and stakeholders

Demonstrated experience in management and leadership of multiple large-scale programs

Advanced knowledge of project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project and/or Critical Chain).

Strong strategic thinking, collaboration and coordination skills to effectively plan and deliver

Project management certification, education, or training (e.g., PMP, Scrum Master, Six Sigma Black/Green Belt)

Critical Chain

Multi-vendor and Supplier Management experience

Good interpersonal and leadership skills

Flexibility in approach; able to adjust to unexpected risks

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title:
Program Manager I - Emergency Response

Reports to:
Head of Programming

Department:
Programming

Location:
Nakivale or Rhino Camp

This position is open to Ugandan nationals only

Deadline:
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Candidates are encouraged to apply by October 23, 2026 no later than 5pm.

Please note that CRS is recruiting in anticipation of an award – recruitment for all candidates is contingent upon successful award of the project.

Background

CRS is seeking Program Manager candidates for an anticipated integrated Shelter and WASH Response for Newly Arrived Refugees and Persons with Specific Needs (PSNs) in Nakivale and Rhino Camp Refugee Settlements. The project will improve the protection, health, and living conditions of newly arrived refugees PSNs in Nakivale and Rhino Camp through increased access to safe shelter, household sanitation, safe water and improved hygiene practices. The position is expected to be based in Nakivale, with regular travel to Rhino Camp for supervision and program oversight.

Job Summary

As the Program Manager, you will lead the management and technical oversight of all Shelter and WASH related programming in the proposed refugee settlements. You will ensure effective systems and processes are in place to support high-quality programming that advances Catholic Relief Services' (CRS) mission of serving poor and vulnerable populations.

The Program Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of project activities in line with the project scope of work, results framework, and M&E plan. The successful candidate will provide technical guidance and capacity strengthening support to local partners and stakeholders and oversee project implementation across assigned geographic areas, ensuring quality, accountability, and timely delivery of results. Your management skills and knowledge will ensure that the CRS Uganda delivers high-quality programming and continuously works towards improving the impact of its emergency response and recovery programming.

Roles And Key Responsibilities

Provide management, guidance, and technical oversight of all Shelter and WASH program activities throughout the project cycle to ensure project design, start-up, implementation and close-out are in line with CRS quality principles and standards, donor guidelines, and industry best practices.
Effectively manage talent for emergency response and recovery programs and supervise. Manage team dynamics and staff well-being . Provide coaching, strategically tailored individual development plans, and complete performance management for direct reports.
Oversee technical assistance and capacity strengthening activities in emergency and humanitarian response for CRS staff, local partner organizations, government counterparts, and other relevant stakeholders to enhance preparedness, response capacity, program quality, and impact.
Provide technical leadership and assistance to strengthen humanitarian systems, policies, standards, and practices in Uganda. Support government, civil society, faith-based, and community actors to develop and operationalize frameworks, standard operating procedures, tools, and guidance at national and subnational levels.
Collaborate with the CRS Uganda Programming leadership and colleagues from the global CRS Humanitarian Response Department to identify, document, and disseminate lessons learned, promising practices, and innovations from proposed Shelter and WASH program. Support knowledge management, adaptive management, and the integration of evidence and learning into program design and implementation.
Contribute to the growth of CRS's emergency and humanitarian response portfolio by proactively identifying funding opportunities and supporting proposal development. Serve as a technical lead and/or writer for emergency and humanitarian response proposals, ensuring quality design, budgeting, staffing plans, and alignment with CRS and donor requirements.
Oversee the identification, assessment and strengthening of partnerships relevant to Shelter, WASH and emergency and humanitarian response, and the appropriate application of partnership concepts, tools and approaches.
Ensure timely and appropriate project expenditures in line with financial plans and efficient use and stewardship of project material sources.
Represent CRS in relevant coordination forums, clusters, and technical working groups, engaging effectively with government counterparts, donors, UN agencies, local partners, and other stakeholders to strengthen collaboration and advance humanitarian and program objectives.

Undertake other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor, consistent with the scope and level of the position, to support evolving programmatic priorities and advance the broader CRS Uganda emergency and humanitarian response portfolio.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills with ability to make sound judgment.
Staff management experience and abilities that are conducive to a learning environment.
Experience using MS Windows and MS Office packages (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Web Conferencing Applications, information management systems.
Good experience in project grants management, including project design, preferably for grants from multiple public donors, including US government and UN.
Demonstrated ability to write high quality technical proposals and reports.
Strong relations management abilities. Ability to relate to people at all levels internally and externally. Strategic in how you approach each relationship.
Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
Proactive, resourceful, solutions-oriented and results-oriented.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in International Development, International Relations, Community Development, or in the field of disaster management, WASH or engineering.
Demonstrated ability to convene, coordinate, and facilitate complex multi-stakeholder consultations and partnerships involving government, development partners, technical agencies, academia, and community stakeholders.

Required Languages
- Fluent English is required. Working proficiency in local language is a plus.

Travel
- include percentage of required travel, if applicable. Could be stated as Must be willing and able to travel up to 30 %.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
Yes, including but not limited to Project Officers and Senior Project Officers and project MEAL staff.

Key Working Relationships

Internal: CRS Country Representative, Head of Programs, Head of Operations, Uganda-based technical experts for MEAL, Gender, Youth and Social Inclusion (GYSI) and Partner Capacity Strengthening (PCS), Regional and Headquarters technical staff.

External: Local partner staff, representatives from for-profit and other non-profit organizations and relevant national, district, sub-county, parish and other government stakeholders, community leaders.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in International Development, International Relations, Community Development, or in the field of disaster management, climate adaptation or resilience required.
Minimum of 5 years' experience inrelevant field-based project management experience.
Strong knowledge of Shelter, WASH and humanitarian response sectors, Uganda's coordination mechanisms, and protection principles to support safe, dignified, and effective planning, coordination, and program implementation.
Experience in managing moderately complex projects.
Experience in an international NGO.
Experience working closely with local partner organizations.

Agency Competencies (for All CRS Staff)

Personal Accountability – Consistently takes responsibility for one’s own actions.
Acts with Integrity - Consistently models values aligned with CRS Guiding Principles and mission. Is considered honest.
Builds and Maintains Trust - Shows consistency between words and actions.
Collaborates with Others – Works effectively in intercultural and diverse teams.
Open to Learn – Seeks out experiences that may change perspective or provide an opportunity to learn new things.

Agency Leadership Competencies

Lead Change – Continually looks for ways to improve the agency through a culture of agility, openness, and innovation.
Develops and Recognizes Others – Builds the capacity of staff to reach their full potential and enhance team and agency performance.
Strategic Mindset – Understands role in translating, communicating, and implementing agency strategy and team priorities.

Please Note

CRS is an Equal Opportunity Employer: We encourage all qualified candidates to apply for this position, including individuals from marginalized backgrounds and people with disabilities. Please ensure you follow the instructions outlined below when applying.

This position is open to Ugandan nationals only.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Candidates are encouraged to apply by October 23, 2026 no later than 5pm.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

About Us

Catholic Relief Services is the official international humanitarian agency of the Catholic community in the United States. Catholic Relief Services works to save, protect, and transform lives in need in more than 100 countries, without regard to race, religion or nationality. Catholic Relief Services’ relief and development work is accomplished through programs of emergency response, HIV, health, agriculture, education, microfinance, and peacebuilding. We welcome as a part of our staff people of all faiths and secular traditions who share our values and our commitment to serving those in need. CRS’ processes and policies reflect our commitment to safeguarding children and vulnerable adults from abuse and exploitation.

CRS welcomes candidates from the countries and regions in which we work. In the event the successful candidate is an expatriate, the anticipated duration of the assignment is informed by a term limit, based on the type and level of the job and the needs of the agency.

CRS is committed to safeguarding program participants, community members, staff and volunteers from all forms of exploitation and abuse.The successful candidate is expected to sign and adhere to CRS´ Code of Conduct.

CRS talent acquisition procedures reflect our commitment to safeguarding the rights and dignity of all people - especially children and vulnerable adults - to live free from abuse and harm.

Disclaimer: This job description is not an exhaustive list of the skill, effort, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.

CRS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are seeking a proactive Technical Project Manager to oversee the delivery of low-voltage infrastructure, CCTV, access control, and networking projects from initial planning through completion. In this fully remote role, you will manage technical deployments across multiple locations while ensuring quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction. You will combine project management expertise with strong technical knowledge to develop accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs), define implementation requirements, and coordinate field operations. Working closely with sales teams, technicians, vendors, and clients, you will contribute to both pre-sales technical scoping and post-sales implementation. This position offers exposure to diverse security and networking technologies within a dynamic, nationwide IT services environment. It is an opportunity to take ownership of complex technical projects while collaborating with distributed teams.

Manage low-voltage infrastructure, CCTV, access control, and networking projects from kickoff to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and client satisfaction.
Develop accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and define technical requirements based on client specifications, floor plans, and site assessments.
Support the sales team with pre-sales technical scoping, including preparing quotes and proposals and conducting technical discovery calls.
Provide post-sales implementation support to ensure solutions are deployed effectively and meet agreed requirements.
Coordinate field technicians, vendors, and clients across multiple locations to ensure smooth project execution.
Oversee the deployment of low-voltage cabling, fiber-optic infrastructure, security systems, and network equipment.
Monitor project progress, address technical or operational challenges, and maintain clear communication with all stakeholders.
Ensure consistent implementation standards and reliable delivery across distributed project sites.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines practical knowledge of low-voltage and security infrastructure with strong project coordination skills and the ability to manage technical deployments remotely. Excellent communication is essential when working with clients, vendors, and internal teams across different time zones.

Strong technical understanding of low-voltage cabling, fiber-optic infrastructure, and physical media installation.
Hands-on knowledge and project oversight experience with CCTV installations and access control systems.
Strong experience with Ubiquiti networking and security ecosystems, including UniFi and UniFi Protect.
Experience with point-to-point (P2P) wireless bridges and outdoor wireless infrastructure, either through fieldwork or project management.
Ability to develop Bills of Materials (BOMs), interpret floor plans, assess technical requirements, and scope implementation solutions.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, vendors, and distributed teams across time zones.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical projects in a fully remote environment.

Als einer der größten Banken-IT-Dienstleister und Digitalisierungspartner Europas sind wir der Treiber der Digitalisierung innerhalb der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. Mit über 5.000 Mitarbeitenden an 3 Standorten machen wir digitales Banking von heute leistungsfähig und entwickeln smarte Finanz-Services von morgen. Dabei bieten wir ein breites Aufgabenspektrum, in dem die individuellen Stärken hervorragend eingebracht werden können. Für die Organisationseinheit AI Applications, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin für den Standort Hannover, Münster oder Frankfurt am Main einen

Project Manager Artificial Intelligence / Generative Artificial Intelligence (m/w/d)
.

KI ist kein Hype, sondern der Schlüssel zu einer besseren Nutzererfahrung.

Unsere KI-Initiativen, wie der S-KIPilot für die Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe, stehen im Zentrum unserer nutzerzentrierten IT- und Geschäftsstrategie. In dieser Rolle werden Technologie, Business und Nutzerbedürfnisse zusammengeführt und sichergestellt, dass KI in Europas größter Finanzgruppe zum strategischen Erfolgsfaktor wird. Hier wird nicht nur Einfluss genommen, sondern neue Standards gesetzt.

Deine Aufgaben:

Werde der Architekt der Zukunft: Übernimm die Leitung (oder Stellvertretende Leitung) innovativer Projekte im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz, die unsere Branche revolutionieren – von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei hast du stets die Nutzer im Fokus, um Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Menschen das Leben erleichtern.
Inspiriere und motiviere: Führe dein Projekt-Team mit Leidenschaft und einer klaren Vision, sodass jeder einzelne über sich hinauswächst und gemeinsam mit dir Großes erreicht.
Setze neue Standards: Bewältige Herausforderungen und finde kreative Lösungen, die nicht nur die Ziele erreichen, sondern neue Maßstäbe setzen – immer unter Berücksichtigung der Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen.
Übernimm die Verantwortung für eine breite Nutzerreichweite: Du trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass die von dir geleiteten Projekte nicht nur innovativ, sondern auch für eine breite Nutzerschaft zugänglich und relevant sind.
Kommuniziere mit Power: Ob mit deinem Projekt-Team oder mit Führungskräften – du sorgst dafür, dass alle wissen, wohin die Reise geht und warum deine Projekte unaufhaltsam sind. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf den Austausch mit den Endnutzer:innen, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Bedürfnisse erfüllt werden.
Denke weiter und setze neue Maßstäbe: Dein Mut, Neues zu wagen, wird uns dabei unterstützen, die nächste Generation von Künstliche Intelligenz-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Nutzer:innen echten Mehrwert bieten.
Arbeite agil und selbstorganisiert: Du bist vertraut mit agilen Methoden und kannst flexibel sowie selbstorganisiert auf neue Anforderungen reagieren. Du treibst eine moderne Arbeitskultur voran, die Raum für Kreativität und schnelle Anpassungen schafft – und so New Work erlebbar macht.

Dein Profil:

Erfahrung, die zählt: Du hast bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Projekte gemanagt und idealerweise Erfahrung im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz oder IT-Projekte gesammelt.
Bildung und Weitsicht: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet dein Fundament. Generative Künstliche Intelligenz ist dir vertraut, und du kennst Technologien wie Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT) und Transformer-Netzwerke – und weißt, wie du sie einsetzen kannst, um nutzerzentrierte Lösungen zu entwickeln. Mind. 6 Jahre fachbezogene Berufserfahrung.

Agilität im Blut: Agile Methoden sind für dich mehr als nur ein Konzept – sie sind die Grundlage deines Erfolgs und helfen dir, Projekte flexibel und effektiv zu steuern, immer mit Blick auf den Nutzen für die Anwender:innen.
Kommunikation, die bewegt: Du kannst komplexe Themen klar und überzeugend vermitteln und alle Beteiligten mit auf die Reise nehmen, wobei du die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen nie aus den Augen verlierst.
Du strebst nach Exzellenz: Eigeninitiative, Selbstorganisation, kreative Lösungen, der Drang, ständig weiterzukommen, ein positives Mindset und Leidenschaft – das zeichnet dich aus. Dein Wissenshunger und deine Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen, treiben dich an, nutzerzentrierte Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Warum du bei uns nicht fehlen darfst:

Gestaltungspower: Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, Projekte zu leiten, die wirklich zählen und die Zukunft prägen, indem sie den Nutzer:innen echten Mehrwert bieten.

Gemeinsame Erfolge: Du gestaltest Projekte, die nicht nur begeistern, sondern auch Maßstäbe setzen – und dabei den Nutzer:innen echten Nutzen bringen.

Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes through technology while balancing business needs, user experience, system capabilities, risks, and scalability.
Monitor HR technology trends, platform capabilities, and vendor roadmaps to recommend improvements and future opportunities.
Establish standards for system configuration, enhancements, testing, releases, documentation, and change management.

Support communication, training, rollout, and adoption of new systems, enhancements, and processes.
Balance immediate operational needs with long-term architecture and business objectives when evaluating solutions and priorities.

Support reporting and analytics solutions that strengthen workforce planning, decision-making, operational visibility, and data consistency.
Establish common workforce data definitions and reliable sources of truth across HR, Finance, and other functions.

new_jobs.title: Protective Intelligence Analyst- OSINT Monitoring and Triage
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly capable Protective Intelligence Analyst to support the protection of senior Vanguard executives globally. This role requires an experienced OSINT practitioner who can independently manage threat identification and triage, prioritize competing executive protection needs, and produce decision-ready intelligence products under time pressure. The position owns the threat identification and initial assessment function for Vanguard’s protective intelligence program, including the daily monitoring and alert queue through which every inbound threat communication, platform alert, and referral receives its initial assessment. The Protective Intelligence Analyst will distinguish credible concerns from noise, open cases for identified security concerns, and manage case tracking and related metrics for the program. The role offers broad exposure across the protective intelligence lifecycle and meaningful ownership of threat intake, applying structured analytic judgment to determine which matters warrant escalation or further investigation.

Monitoring & Triage

Manage daily alert and intake queues: vendor alerting feeds, the program’s intake channels, executive-assistant and partner referrals, and regional intelligence routing.
Triage inbound items against the program’s established threat screening criteria; disposition items as unfounded with documented rationale or open cases for investigation.
Provide dedicated monitoring coverage during executive travel and event windows, assessing emerging developments in real time and escalating per defined criteria.
Maintain watchlist hygiene and help fine tune OSINT feeds to ensure reliable threat identification.

Case Management & Intelligence Production

Maintain key protective intelligence trackers/metrics: request log, alert log, case entries, product IDs, and dashboard integrity.
Conduct OSINT collection and analysis for protective intelligence assessments, documenting sources and findings and contributing analytic judgments to final products.
Draft the program’s weekly intelligence summary, synthesizing alert activity, case developments, and emerging threat trends into concise, decision-ready reporting.
Process intake acknowledgements and maintain records-handling standards for intake channels.

Team Model – Primary Focus, Universal Capability

Triage and monitoring is the primary focus of this role, not an exclusive lane. Every Protective Intelligence Analyst trains to produce the program’s core assessment products to standard, rotates through triage and monitoring coverage, and serves as designated backup for at least one other product line, so the team carries no single points of failure.
Cross-train teammates in triage and monitoring, maintain current proficiency in teammates’ specialties, and participate in the program’s dual-review and after-action practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, intelligence studies, security studies, psychology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Minimum of three years of related experience in a field such as intelligence analysis, GSOC/watch operations, journalism/research, or military/law-enforcement analysis.
Demonstrated ability to work a high-volume queue with consistency, accuracy, and documented decisions.
Strong OSINT skills, including the ability to locate, verify, and assess the credibility of information across open sources.
Comfort with reading concerning or threatening content professionally and escalating appropriately.
High ethical standards and discretion when handling sensitive executive and corporate information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders clearly and calmly under time pressure.
Proven ability to think critically and assess incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting information.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with threat intelligence, alerting, or case management platforms.
Formal training or applied experience in threat assessment, targeted violence prevention, or intelligence analysis.
ATAP membership, with active interest or progress toward obtaining the Certified Threat Manager (CTM) designation.

Special Factors

Participation in an on-call rotation for after-hours escalation support as the program matures.
Early-morning queue coverage; occasional evening and weekend surge coverage during executive travel windows.
Occasional domestic travel (

Special Factors

new_jobs.title: Investigations Analyst - Threats
new_jobs.description:
The Central Investigations team is dedicated to keeping users of the Meta technologies safe. We pride ourselves in helping prevent harm by applying deep subject matter expertise to identify and mitigate potential safety-related threats to keep Meta and its users more secure. Our team is seeking an experienced investigator who will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging, high-visibility risks the company faces and the opportunity to have a substantial impact.We are seeking an investigator with experience in understanding and mitigating issues around terrorism, violent extremism, and other related harm types. In addition to having a demonstrated investigative and analytical background, we are seeking an investigator who has experience with open source investigations and who is committed to protecting people. The successful candidate will be able to assess and analyze large amounts of data in order to identify sources of potential threats and abuses, operate independently in a fast-paced environment, and proactively collaborate with teams across the company.

Investigations Analyst - Threats Responsibilities:

Investigate issues around terrorism and violent extremism and how they impact Meta, our products and our communities, with a focus on understanding how bad actors may try to utilize our family of apps and services
Investigate complex cases and conduct deep analysis of potential threats that may manifest on Meta technologies
Prioritize and manage concurrent analyzes based on threat severity, impact, and stakeholder needs
Identify sources of abusive behavior, quickly and accurately assessing the credibility of potential threats in order to mitigate risk of harm
Work cross-functionally with other analytic and investigative teams across the company, including collaborating with Policy, Engineering, and Integrity partners
Gather, analyse, and synthesize relevant data to identify potential abuse
Work with graphic and sensitive content on a regular basis
Make sound, timely decisions in time-sensitive threat scenarios with minimal supervision

Minimum Qualifications:

8+ years of professional experience in investigations or analysis in law enforcement, security, risk, or safety domains
Experience working with sensitive issues that include graphic violence, extremist content, a variety of religious and political views, and adult content
Experience analyzing large datasets to identify credible threat indicators and actionable intelligence
Subject matter knowledge on terror organizations and/or violent extremism actors, especially pertaining to various social media platforms, analytical tools, and online research tools
Experience handling and protecting highly confidential information
Experience communicating investigative findings and recommendations in writing to cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working with a team spanning multiple locations/time zones
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience conducting open source investigations and/or investigations on behalf of a technology company
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Proficiency in languages other than English is preferred because the role involves investigating content and threats in specific non-English-speaking regions and communities served by Meta platforms
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Knowledge of data tools such as SQL, Python, or other data analytics programming coding languages and data visualization tools

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

You’ll assess bomber platforms, weapons, tankers, command-and-control systems, testing, and emerging technologies; translate warfighter needs into modernization and investment priorities; and brief senior leaders. Bomber employment experience is required. TS/SCI eligibility required.

The Air Force Civilian Service (AFCS) is looking for an Air Delivery Program Analyst (NH-0343-03) to work at USSTRATCOM/J87 at Offutt Air Force Base, Located in Bellevue, Nebraska.

In this position you will analyze, evaluate issues, develop recommendations, and determine necessary policies, regulations, directives, doctrine, and procedures in support of major command program(s). Supports development of Commander, USSTRATCOM (CDRUSSTRATCOM) Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) and Joint Capability Integration and Development Systems (JCIDS) submissions, major Defense Acquisition programs, and Congressional analyses. Additionally, supports air-delivered platforms, associated weapons, command and control (C2) architectures, and enabling capabilities/technologies development, modernization, recapitalization, force management, and analysis to include integrating, coordinating, prioritizing, and advocating for USSTRATCOM future concepts, mission capability needs, and weapon system development that directly affects the Department of Defense (DoD), United States Air Force (USAF), the air-delivered nuclear enterprise, and supporting inter-agency organizations.

This is a Direct Hiring Authority (DHA) position.

This position can close at any time. Apply Now!

Scientific Games is seeking a Data Analyst to turn business data into reliable analysis that helps internal teams and lottery customers understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed operating decisions.

The analyst will work with business partners, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to define analytical needs, prepare and validate data, and build reusable solutions using cloud-based platforms such as Databricks. Create and maintain reports, dashboards, notebooks, visualizations, and analytical workflows that support revenue growth, cost reduction, operational performance, and customer success.
Use cloud-based data platforms, particularly Databricks, SQL, notebooks, governed datasets, and reusable workflows.
Translate business questions into analytical approaches, data requirements, success measures, and practical recommendations for internal teams and external lottery customers.
Build dashboards, reporting assets, and self-service data products using appropriate visualization tools.
Use GitHub or similar version control tools to manage analytical code, notebooks, documentation, peer feedback, and project history.
Automate recurring analysis, data preparation, quality checks, and distribution processes where practical.
Work with data engineering and business teams to improve data collection, transformation logic, metric definitions, and shared datasets.

Develop studies, research reports, executive dashboards, sales enablement tools, and exploratory visualizations that identify useful insights and business growth opportunities.
Identify process improvements and develop solutions that reduce rework, improve confidence in data, and make future analysis easier to repeat.

Collaborate effectively in a remote environment through written updates, shared documentation, and collaboration tools.
Travel occasionally to lottery and corporate locations as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, applied statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field.
At least three years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, reporting, analytics engineering, data science, or a closely related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, data validation, and working with information from multiple sources.
Hands-on experience, coursework, certification, or practical exposure to Databricks or comparable cloud analytics platforms, including notebook-based analysis, lakehouse concepts, Spark SQL, or PySpark.
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics environments in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including shared workspaces, governed datasets, and scalable computing environments.
Experience with Python or a similar programming language for analysis, data preparation, automation, or reproducible workflows.
Familiarity with GitHub or similar version control tools, including commits, branches, pull requests or review workflows, and project documentation.
Ability to design effective dashboards and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Sigma, or comparable business intelligence tools.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to collect, organize, analyze, interpret, and communicate significant amounts of information accurately.
Ability to explain analytical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations in clear language for business teams, executives, and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in data science, applied statistics, analytics, or a related field.
Experience contributing to reusable data models, metric layers, feature datasets, or certified analytical tables that support multiple business uses.
Experience automating recurring reporting or analytics workflows through scheduled jobs, orchestration tools, notebooks, scripts, or CI-style validation.
Working knowledge of data quality practices, testing methods, data lineage, documentation, and governance in modern analytics environments.
Experience with Alteryx, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or similar transformation and orchestration tools.
Familiarity with forecasting, segmentation, regression, classification, or other statistical methods used in business analysis.
Experience supporting sales, operations, gaming, lottery, retail, or other transaction-intensive business areas.

Ability to develop analytical work that is reusable, maintainable, auditable, and scalable.

Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams, business partners, executives, and customer stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively, seek feedback, and contribute to shared analytical standards.

supports end‑to‑end risk adjustment and revenue cycle operations by analyzing HCC submissions by ArchWell Health and any rejections at Clearninghouse/payer/CMS level, managing chart‑retrieval and review workflows, and ensuring accurate ingestion of care‑gap and clinical documentation data for various sources. HCC Reconciliation & Submission Validation

Analyze payer acceptance, rejections, and 277CA/999 acknowledgement files.
Identify new, recaptured, and dismissed HCCs and reconcile against internal systems (VIM, HCC engine).
Present and route any rejections/gaps for appropriate teams.

Sweeps & Payer Data Management

Review sweeps datasets to ensure completeness, accuracy, and payer acceptance.
Support ASM workflows and monitor acceptance/rejection trends.
Track payer healthcare gaps and validate alignment with internal care‑gap logic.

Monitor chart‑retrieval programs, turnaround times, and vendor performance.
ROI analysis of various programs
Manage unlinked charts and ensure proper linkage to members, service dates, and HCCs.

Care‑Gap & Clinical Data Ingestion

Support ingestion/analysis health plan care‑gap files and ensure accurate mapping into VIM and analyze suspects conversion rate from various sources.
Validate care‑gap completeness and partner with clinical teams to ensure data is actionable.
Develop or refine member stratification logic for outreach and in‑home visit prioritization.

Reporting & Analytics

Build/Maintain dashboards and reports to track HCC operations work inclusive of reconciliation, chart‑retrieval progress, and rejection trends.
Provide insights to leadership on productivity, throughput, and operational bottlenecks at market/center/payer level.
Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and recommending process enhancements.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Operations, RCM, Coding, Clinical Documentation, Vendor partners, and IT/Data teams.
Participate in governance meetings to review trends, exceptions, and payer‑specific issues.
Ensure alignment across teams to reduce sweeps‑level escalations and maintain steady‑state workflows.

3-5 years of experience in risk adjustment, RCM, healthcare analytics, or payer operations.

Deep experience with SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
Ability to interpret clinical documentation and coding outputs (ICD‑10, HCC mapping).
Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
Experience working with chart‑retrieval vendors or clinical documentation teams preferred.

Competencies

Detail‑oriented with strong data validation skills
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines
Strong cross‑functional collaboration
Comfort working in fast‑paced, evolving operational environments
Commitment to accuracy, compliance, and documentation integrity

Success in this role requires someone who can comfortably navigate both the technical details of software development and the bigger-picture business objectives behind the products being delivered.

This position will be hybrid based out of our Niles, IL HQ.

Responsibilities

Leads product development projects through the development process from requirements gathering, UX development, implementation, testing, and public release.
Diverse projects may include complexities related to:
1) Technical engineering requirements.
2) Co-development partnerships.
3) Managing shared code development that may be used on multiple projects.
4) The management of multiple concurrent projects.

Forms and co-locates cross-functional teams focused on delivering new or upgrading existing products by utilizing standard project management tools and templates (based off of the Scaled Agile
Framework (SAFe)) and negotiating with Department Managers to obtain necessary resources.

Leads teams with members in various locations and time zones.
Coordinates and manages project manpower estimations, budget, risk, and task duration to determine overall project cost to ensure projects adhere to plans. Approves project expenditures as necessary.
Coordinate requirements and maintain relationships with external vendors and suppliers; serves as internal project liaison with outside design firms needed to achieve project goals.
Manages technical problem-solving efforts by guiding decision-making, exploring alternatives, soliciting opinion, pursuing root cause, and coordinating experiments while maintaining project/product cost, product quality and on-time delivery.
Provides leadership to Project Team members and Department Managers through motivation, influence, and coaching.
Prepares post-project assessment, compiles lessons learned, and suggests improvements to the new product development process.
Perform any other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field, Computer Science or Software Engineering preferred.
Demonstrated abilities to lead and coach product development teams
Minimum of 5 years of experience in new product implementation to include broad knowledge in some or all the following disciplines: Requirements development and management, Software Engineering, integration with hardware and network systems, test development. Desktop and mobile application development a plus.
Minimum of 3 years of leading project teams in a direct report or dotted/matrix environment.
Knowledge of Project Management concepts and agile software development methods (Scrum). Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) is a plus.
Demonstrated abilities with e-tools including project scheduling software, PLM or PDM software, requirements management etc.
Performance management skills, including the ability to create and execute change. Demonstrated leadership, coaching and team building abilities.
Demonstrated leadership in managing teams in multiple locations and time zones
Uses good judgment in selecting practical, effective, and timely solutions.
Able to interact with senior management or executive levels on matters concerning functional areas, divisions, and/or customers.

Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Shure will not sponsor applicants for this position for work visas.

Who We Are

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Join Shure and Amplify Your Impact.
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

As a Project Manager, you'll start your day by reviewing active projects, priorities, budgets, and schedules to ensure work is progressing toward successful and profitable completion. Liaise with internal groups and other LBR groups (HR, Finance, Purchasing, Equipment, etc.) as required

Perform other related duties as assigned

Possession of Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical, Molecular, Biology, Immunology, or other related field from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) or four (4) years relevant experience in lieu of degree. Project Manager / Quality Assurance – Fire Protection System Upgrade

About The Role

Peregrine Solutions is hiring an on-site Project Manager / Quality Assurance lead for a full fire alarm and life safety system replacement in an occupied, high-rise federal office building in Bethesda, MD. You will be the owner’s eyes on site. You will hold the installing contractor to the approved design, specifications and code, from mobilization through final acceptance and closeout.

Serve as the day-to-day on-site lead and report to the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and Project Manager.

Manage closeout: redline and final as-built drawings, O&M manuals, recorded training, spare parts inventory and warranty start.

Hands-on experience with addressable emergency voice/alarm communication systems, including testing and acceptance in occupied buildings.

Experience managing fire protection impairments, fire watch and hot-work programs on active sites.
Experience on federal construction projects, including the submittal, RFI and daily reporting process.
OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification.
U.S. citizen, able to obtain and keep an HSPD-12 federal credential (PIV card) and pass a background investigation.

Familiarity with emergency responder radio systems (ERCES / in-building public safety communications), NFPA 1225 and radio coverage testing.

new_jobs.description:
Job ID: req4683

Employee Type: exempt full-time

Division: Vaccine, Immunity and Cancer Directorate

Facility: Frederick: ATRF

Location: 8560 Progress Dr, Frederick, MD 21701 USA

The Frederick National Laboratory is operated by Leidos Biomedical Research, Inc. The lab addresses some of the most urgent and intractable problems in the biomedical sciences in cancer and AIDS, drug development and first-in-human clinical trials, applications of nanotechnology in medicine, and rapid response to emerging threats of infectious diseases.

Accountability, Compassion, Collaboration, Dedication, Integrity and Versatility; it's the FNL way.

Program Description

The Vaccine, Immunity and Cancer Directorate (VICD) has a primary mission to provide scientific leadership and laboratory infrastructure to study immune responses to Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines and other cancer preventive strategies in the context of preclinical and clinical studies. As of part of a recent large effort, the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) and the Frederick National Laboratory (FNL) and other stakeholders are developing and evaluating vaccines with durable protection against influenza. VICD is leading the development of immunoassays with the highest reproducibility, sensitivity, and specificity for evaluation of immune responses induced by vaccination in clinical trials.

The Vaccine, Immunity, and Cancer Directorate (VICD) at the Frederick National Laboratory has a primary mission to provide scientific leadership and laboratory infrastructure to study immune responses to Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines, other cancer preventive strategies and other viruses in the context of clinical and pre-clinical studies.

Our core values of accountability, compassion, collaboration, dedication, integrity, and versatility serve as a guidepost for how we do our work every day in serving the public’s interest.

Key Roles/Responsibilities

The Scientific Data Analyst II will be responsible for working directly with VICD Director, Managers and laboratory staff to manage large datasets and conduct data analyses of immunological data, including serology assay data, flow cytometry and other data generated by the laboratory in support of large clinical and epidemiological studies. The incumbent will work closely with the Scientific Manager and laboratory staff to provide statistical analysis, data trending, power calculations and study design. This is an onsite work position. No telework option.

The Scientific Data Analyst Will

Build and manage databases to support large-scale immunological laboratory datasets.

Perform review of lab data and associated documentation for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to quality standards

Perform validations of templates used for data acquisition and analysis following pre-defined procedures.

Perform complex data analyses, data QC, and data interpretation in a timely manner within projected timelines.

Automate data collection and analysis processes for improved efficiency and reproducibility.

Prepare manual of procedures for data collection and data analyses.

Analyze large amounts of data to identify biomarker measurement trends and patterns employing new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.

Provide study design guidance to study investigators, such as power calculations and determine most appropriate statistical methods.

Identify appropriate statistical methodology needed to meet study objectives, include assay qualification and validation.

Perform statistical analyses of large, complex datasets from clinical trials and large epidemiological and longitudinal studies using appropriate statistical software packages.

Design and generate tables and graphs in publication-quality form, and present results to managers and directors in a regular basis.

Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical models, and perform statistical analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements.

Prepare and deliver reports for interim and final analyses, including data sections for quality control and validation proposals and reports.

Write and review statistical sections of study proposals, protocols, and manuscripts.

Review study proposals, including clinical trials and apply standards to create summary data reports.

Efficiently troubleshoot or report any unexpected technical and analytical problems.

Effectively communicate with all data generators and submitters to address requests, questions and concerns and clearly document actions taken.

Basic Qualifications

To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below:

Possession of a Master’s degree in Statistics, Computational Sciences, Data Sciences from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) in a related field. Foreign degrees must be evaluated for U.S. equivalency.

In addition to the education requirement, a minimum of two (2) years of progressively responsible experience in data analyses.

Strong knowledge of statistics and scientific data analyses.

Experience working with databases containing large data sets.

Statistical programming languages such as R Script and SAS, applied to biomedical studies.

Experience in evaluation of assay performance by applying appropriate statistical trend analysis.

Strong analytical skills.

Experience with data management, Lab Information Management Systems and data transfer from different platforms.

Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with these desired skills will be given preferential consideration:

Ph.D. in Statistics, Computational Sciences, Data Sciences.

A minumum of five (5) years related data analyses experience.

Deep understanding and experience in processing high throughput biomedical data: data cleaning, normalization, analysis, interpretation and visualization.

Ability to understand and analyze data from complex experimental and epidemiological designs involving immunology, serology and biomarker assay data.

Proficiency with Python, R, MATLAB, or similar scientific programming languages.

Experience preparing scientific publications and presenting research findings in various technical and scientific forums.

Ability to understand and analyze data from complex experimental and epidemiological designs involving immunology, serology and biomarker assay data.

Experience in assay development, reference standard data analyses in GxP laboratory environment.

JOB HAZARDS

This position is subject to working with or has the potential for exposure to infectious material, requiring medical clearance and immunizations.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, color, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

Pay and Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available here

This role serves as the primary liaison between project teams, engineering functions, Process Development, laboratory stakeholders, vendors, and facility operations to ensure successful facility build-out, equipment relocation, utility readiness, commissioning, qualification, and operational readiness activities.

Collaborate with Engineering, Facilities, Quality, EHS, IT/Automation, Operations, CQV teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure successful project execution.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all levels of an organization.

WFI, clean utilities, and facility infrastructure systems.

GMP-regulated biotechnology and pharmaceutical facilities.

About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC, we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

Location:

This is a US-based remote position, with occasional on-site visits to Arlington, VA as required (travel at employee's expense).

Employment Type:

Full-Time Monday Through Friday 7:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.

Security Clearance:

No security clearance required. Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

Job Summary

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking a Senior Information Assurance (IA) Analyst / Program Manager to support the Headquarters, Department of the Army G-1, Directorate of Prevention, Resilience, and Readiness (DPRR) Information Assurance Support Services (IASS) program. This key personnel role leads the Information Assurance program for the Drug and Alcohol Management Information System (DAMIS), the Risk Reduction Unit Risk Inventory Application, and associated standalone applications hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud. Serving as the Information Assurance Security Officer (IASO) and the Contracting Officer Representative's (COR) main point of contact, this position owns Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate (ATO) maintenance and reauthorization, and supervises the IA Analyst. Core hours are 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the overall Information Assurance program for DAMIS under the direction of the System Owner/COR and the Program Information Systems Security Manager (P-ISSM), serving as IASO and the COR's main point of contact.
Manage the system's Risk Management Framework (RMF) process; prepare, coordinate, and submit security documentation for review and routing to the approving authority, and adapt to changing requirements from TBAI, Army CIO, or DoW.
Use the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) to obtain and maintain the system ATO; perform weekly continuous monitoring of ATO requirements, STIGs, and Control Correlation Identifiers (CCIs) and report weekly ATO status with a remediation plan.
Develop and maintain the RMF modernization and timeline plan with ATO milestones, and prepare and submit the ATO reauthorization package in eMASS before the current ATO expires.
Manage the vulnerability compliance report and lead annual contingency, security, and recovery tests, submitting documentation within 2 business days of test completion.
Prepare FISMA-compliant reports and update information assurance data in the Army Portfolio Management System (APMS), Army Asset & Vulnerability Tracking Resource (A&VTR), and eMASS.
Prepare and submit the Monthly Status Report (MSR) on RMF compliance, challenges, issues, and prior-month activity.
Serve as a member of the agency's Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT), acknowledging incidents within 15 minutes and initiating approved mitigation within one hour during duty hours; maintain the Emergency Operations Plan.
Review system change requests and recommend implementation or alternatives based on IA vulnerabilities within 2 business days.
Attend IA working groups, conferences, and recurring meetings virtually or in person, and provide minutes and recommendations within 2 business days.
Supervise the IA Analyst, review deliverables for quality, and provide backup coverage for IA Analyst tasks.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
At least 6 years of technical and compliance experience maintaining a system's security posture and managing security within a Microsoft Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environment.
At least 2 years of experience leading teams.
Proven IA/cybersecurity experience managing the security posture of systems involving .NET, Windows, Azure, Oracle, and Red Hat.
Strong background in data architecture, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Red Hat and Windows security and administration.
Extensive experience implementing and auditing against DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists to oversee RMF processes and continuous monitoring.
Demonstrated ability to maintain a system's ATO and obtain a new ATO.
Experience using eMASS.
Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical staff, program leadership, and Government stakeholders.
Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation prior to start.
Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with ACAS, SCAP Compliance Checker, and DISA STIG Viewer.
Experience supporting systems through RMF changes such as the transition from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 4 to Revision 5.
Experience supporting Army systems hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud.
Experience with systems handling Privacy Act, PII, or HIPAA-protected data.
Experience with FISMA reporting in APMS and A&VTR.

Certifications

Active Tier 3 (NACI) or higher background investigation prior to start.
DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (e.g., CISSP, CGRC/CAP, CISM, GSLC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment.
DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment. CISSP satisfies both IAM Level II and IAT Level II.
